workItems.solution: MDP OVH corrigé côté porteur. Ajout CLI scripts/mobile/fetch-imap-verification.js --check-only. Correction require ../mobile/lib/resolve-email-triage-env. Fallback EMAIL_TRIAGE_READ_* dans mail-connection-policy.js.

workItems.title: Récap agent HTML lisible et standardisé

workItems.solution: Script run-playwright-mailhog-e2e.sh : bascule temporaire auth-service → mailhog:1025, charge .env, restore SMTP après tests.
